The '''cardio package''', also known as the '''cardio enhancement package''' or '''cardio implant''', was a type of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant that could improve the vitality and fitness of the user by encouraging the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] to release certain chemicals. The implant required training to use properly and could be found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], in [[3956 BBY]], and the ensuing [[Dark Wars]], in [[3951 BBY]].

==Description==
The cardio package was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Brain/Legends|brain]] implant that micromanaged the cardiovascular system of an [[Species/Legends|organic being]], allowing the user's physical fitness and endurance to improve faster and to a greater extent than would normally be possible through exercise.<ref name="KOTOR" /> The implant, which cost between nine hundred<ref name="TSL" /> and four thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], accomplished this by encouraging the brain to send certain revitalizing chemicals to the user's organs, particularly the [[Heart/Legends|heart]]. The complex nature of a cybernetic implant meant that the user needed training in their use and could only use one such implant at a [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Campaign" /> 

The implant could be constructed at a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] station with sufficient chemicals and medical knowledge.<ref name="TSL" /> A more powerful [[Bavakar cardio package|version]] of the cybernetic, manufactured by the innovative [[Bavakar Medical Research Labs]] and costing two thousand credits, allowed cardiovascular function far higher than the user's typical performance.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==History==
{{Quote|Your son Casus is dead. I have seen his body.''"<br />''"Casus&hellip; is dead? I was afraid of this, yet in my heart I knew it must be true.|Revan and Nurik Sandral|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:Casussandral.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The body of Casus Sandral, who used a cardio package, was found in the grasslands of Dantooine.]]
An individual used the implant at the time of their [[Death/Legends|death]] while exploring the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow|Tomb]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] on<ref name="KOTOR" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Campaign" /> [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date1">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], some [[Republic soldier]]s were provided the implant as part of their equipment. [[Casus Sandral]], an amateur [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] who lived on<ref name="KOTOR" /> the Outer Rim planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="Campaign" /> in the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date1" /> carried a cardio package when he was killed by [[Kath hound/Legends|kath hounds]] in Dantooine's [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]]. The [[Gender/Legends|man's]] body was discovered by the [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], now [[Jedi training/Legends|retrained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], while mediating the [[Sandral-Matale feud|feud]] between Casus Sandral's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Nurik Sandral|Nurik]], and his [[Sandral family|family]], and the [[Matale family|Matales]], another family that lived on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agrarian world]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

A version of the cardio package manufactured by Bavakar Medical Research Labs was used by [[Shasa]], a female [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] in [[Sith training|training]] on<ref name="KOTOR" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Waterworld/Legends|aquatic planet]]<ref name="Campaign" /> [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> During the ensuing [[Dark Wars]]<ref name="TSL" /> half a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, in [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="Date2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' in [[3951 BBY]].</ref> the implant could be purchased from [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TSL" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I heard you convinced Nadaa to sell herself to me. Ha! Beautiful! You have amused me. You are most compliant for a human. Take this small token of my appreciation. I'm certain one as&hellip; resourceful as you will find a use for it. But do not think I despise you any less.|translated=1|Saquesh, to Meetra Surik in potential dialogue|<ref name="TSL" />}}
[[File:Saquesh1.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Saquesh has a chance to give the player a cardio package if they choose a dark side option.]]
The cardio package first appeared as an equipment item in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> The implant appeared in [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]], published in 2003 by [[Prima Games]], under the name cardio enhancement package.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[2008]] ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', a supplement to their ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', identifies the cybernetic as the cardio implant.<ref name="Campaign" />

In ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'', the implant requires the level one implant feat to equip and will increase the player's constitution ability by one. If the player selects the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] class, they will automatically receive the cardio package in an equipment [[Footlocker/Legends|footlocker]] during the tutorial aboard the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'', along with the feat required to use the device. The implant can also be found in the remains of Casus Sandral on Dantooine and [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] remains on Korriban. Interactions with the corpses are optional,<ref name="KOTOR" /> but the 2008 reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' establishes that<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|126|Sandral, Nurik}}</ref> the "Dead Settler" and "Sandral-Matale Feud" quests<ref name="KOTOR" /> were completed;<ref name="CSWE" /> Revan thus must have discovered Sandral's body and personal effects. The player can not acquire the Bavakar cardio package from Shasa without killing her,<ref name="KOTOR" /> but the seventh web enhancement for the ''Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide'' establishes that Shasa was rescued by Revan and survived.<ref name="Shasa">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/KOTORweben7|text=KOTOR Campaign Guide Web Enhancement 7: Shasa}}</ref>

The [[2004]] sequel, ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', uses randomized inventory for vendors, loot dropped, and rewards throughout the game, giving a chance, but not a guarantee, for the implant to appear in many locations. The item may appear in the inventory or as a reward from the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Samhan Dobo]] on [[Citadel Station]] [[Orbit/Legends|above]] the [[Bombing of Telos IV|devastated]] planet [[Telos IV]], the Duros [[Oondar]], the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Saquesh]], and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Fassa (Twi'lek)|Fassa]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Margar]] and [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gegorran]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Kex]] on Onderon's moon [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Adum Larp]] in the [[Matale estate|headquarters]] of the [[Khoonda]] government on Dantooine. The implant only has a chance to appear as a reward from the [[Exchange]]'s [[Refugee Sector]] overseer Saquesh while the player is levels four through six, and from [[Nar Shaddaa Docks|dock]] master Fassa by completing the "Fassa's [[Freighter/Legends|Freighters]]" quest while levels seven through nine. The player will only receive a reward from Saquesh by completing the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] option during the "Sold to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]" quest, convincing the [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] [[Nadaa]] to sell herself into [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] to accompany her [[Reproduction/Legends|daughter]], [[Adana (Human)|Adana]], who had been kidnapped by the Quarren.<ref name="TSL" />
